profile.headline: Software Engineer at McGraw Hill | Fulbright Scholar
profile.summary:
Hi! I'm Dani, a Filipina-American designer and developer. My work primarily involves building technologies that make experiences more equitable and more accessible — particularly for learners and people with disabilities. Driven by a desire to actualize the types of tools I'd like to see in the world. 

danielle-cruz.com

positions.title: Fulbright Scholar
positions.description: English Teaching Assistant at the Universidade Federal da Bahia (UFBA)

positions.title: Graduate Course Assistant
positions.description:
CS124, From Languages to Information with Dan Jurafsky
CS193X, Web Programming Fundamentals with Michael Chang
CS148, Introduction to Computer Graphics and Imaging with Ron Fedkiw

positions.title: Fullstack Engineering Intern
positions.description: Led development of a spatial-based focus management solution for the Vimeo OTT TV application for Samsung, UWP, and Google Cast. Coded in React.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a data visualization dashboard to help teachers and district administrators better track students’ progress in academics and social-emotional learning overtime. Coded in React, MongoDB, GraphQL.

positions.title: Learning Engineering Fellow
positions.description: One of 30 fellows selected from 200+ applicants to participate in an ed-tech talent outreach program hosted by Schmidt Futures and UC Berkeley for students with backgrounds in both CS and education. Team awarded $25,000 (1st place) for our capstone project in second-language education.

positions.title: Resident Assistant, Branner Hall
positions.description: Collaborated with co-staff to manage dormitory of 120 upperclass residents. Coordinated academic, cultural, and social activities to promote community-building.

positions.title: Education Programs Intern
positions.description: Recipient of the Donald Kennedy Fellowship through the Stanford Haas Center. Analyzed English as a Second Language (ESOL) education strategies and drafted curriculum revisions for board members. Directed community-based research with Chinese- and Spanish-speaking immigrants in Sunset Park, Brooklyn.

positions.title: Cardinal Quarter Peer Advisor
positions.description: Advised students about planning for public service internships through weekly office hours and organized student panels.

positions.title: English Program Founder / Teacher
positions.description: Recipient of the Donald Kennedy Fellowship through the Stanford Haas Center. Designed and implemented two 8-week English courses for 40 low-income high school students. Facilitated cultural workshops for students and teachers in both English and Brazilian Portuguese.

projects.title: Guia
projects.description:
A Chrome extension interface that guides learners through real-world texts in Portuguese. It can be used to gauge the difficulty of online web pages/articles, as well as recommend articles based on the desired difficulty — all while browsing the web. Guia ultimately aims to empower users with the ability to take language-learning into their own hands and freely engage with Portuguese more authentically.

Presented at Schmidt Future's Learning Engineering Expo and awarded first place with a prize of $25,000.

projects.title: SoundSight
projects.description: A visualization engine to create better representations of background music and environmental sounds in video content for Deaf and Hard of Hearing users.
